title: Qwen3-Omni Talker Finetune: label recipe, label checker and fine-tuning toolkit
description: Recipe to reproduce the speech labels of Qwen3-Omni's Talker (kyutai Mimi, first 16 codebooks, moshi package with bf16 weights, tail-padded input), a label checker based on Talker likelihoods, and a LoRA fine-tuning toolkit for new voices. Accompanies the technical report 'Reproducing the Speech Labels of Qwen3-Omni's Talker: Mimi in bf16, and a Last-Frame Pitfall'.

creators.name: Chen, Yuxuan
creators.affiliation: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
